comment: Hand-computed. EMA(3), k=2/(3+1)=0.5, SMA-seeded convention: seed = SMA(first 3) = (2+1+8)/3 = 3.6666667 emitted at index 2; then i3 = 3.6667 + 0.5*(4-3.6667) = 3.8333333; i4 = 3.8333 + 0.5*(6-3.8333) = 4.9166667. NOTE: first-value-seeded implementations diverge here (they would emit from index 1 with different values) — this fixture pins the SMA-seeded convention deliberately because it is the standard TA-lib-style choice.
